title: Prove restoration-generation lifetime for the literal QQ16 ordinary caller
body:
[#5362](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5362) by [@mihir-s-05](https://github.com/mihir-s-05) bounds restoration metadata under an explicit retained-pair premise. This PR establishes the caller-side premise for the literal ordinary caller retained from [#2809](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2809), using a source root/stack audit and an executable lifetime calibration.

The caller retains one five-record generation at completed dispatch boundaries. During restoration, the old and new generations need at most **ten generation records**, independently of recursion depth or the number of returns. Parent continuations are encoded rather than held in recursive dispatcher frames. Root completion retains its final five wrappers; numerical cleanup does not retire them.

This gives subsequent frontend work a source-specific lifetime invariant instead of requiring each contribution to assume or re-investigate the same retention boundary. It builds on the source-handle work in [#5330](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5330) by [@JoyboyBrian](https://github.com/JoyboyBrian).

### Validation

- The unchanged original physical caller fixture completes 5,859 macros and 12 CALL/RETURN pairs. All 25 completed generations satisfy the checks: peak ten, final five. Its complete predecessor physical receipt is unchanged.
- Four source mutations and three executed alias faults are rejected, including retained binding/arena history and an extra Program edge.
- Source pins, package metadata, optimized structural checks and committed-byte export checks pass. The physical calibration completed in 130 seconds with about 58 MiB sampled peak RSS on CPython 3.12.8.

### Scope

Only `research/qq16-restoration-root-closure/` is added. The proof covers the specific ordinary caller and concrete binding paths; the executed fixture uses ToyBinding. Ten bounds completed-generation records during restoration, not all constructor temporaries or retained storage. Complete QQ16 Installation ownership, numerical `new_context` costs, frontend F(K), production supplier execution and selected-frontier changes remain outside this result. Full source-history checking is unavailable in the shallow checkout.

Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in investigation, proof, implementation and assisted review; original source attribution and notices are retained.
